detail.actual: Dwarven descendants, salamander-like cultures, infernal contractors, free constructs, and trapped craft families can all plausibly exist here. Their politics revolve around fuel, formulas, labor, ownership, and whether the Anvil is sacred, stolen, or merely useful. citation.excerpt: Twelve higher catalog cards remain blocked-pending-operational-review; two transport proposals are unadopted.

resolvedValue: Matrix P92 permits escape magic to Floor1 but says it ends the current descent. This is original-source narrative, not a license to overwrite the separately reviewed expedition/extraction procedures. Exact live comparison remains required.
Matrix P94/P99/P109/P114/P119/P135 guardian ordering differs from July Q7 live roster. A cosmology reading must not re-promote that source ordering as current play data.
Matrix P139–140 places an Old God between tiers7/8 with nonordinary geometry. Preserve this alongside World P7 Floor97 and current Director distinction; no identity merger.
The twelve read current catalog cards are operationally null. Eight central transit dependencies plus Blink, Banishment and two Planar Summons variants are still unresolved in operational scope.

Teleport Object and Teleportation Circle have complete unadopted procedures with two examples each. Circle same-plane network choices are explicitly NEW; they do not settle cross-plane routes. A comparison attachment does not equal dedicated spell acceptance.

Teleport and Ethereal Disjunction have source questions but no complete procedure in the higher-rank index; Plane Shift, Planar Gate, Astral Projection, Etherealness, Banishment and both Planar Summons variants have literal receipts only. Blink is outside that higher-rank index and remains separately recorded as receipt-only-post-push-cosmology.

No core default action/range/duration is adopted as a newly verified individual spell procedure. No new planar reach, route, entity identity, dungeon bypass, summoning body, cost or flag is introduced.
